messages:
Sasha: Morning — quick status update from the kernel side. PR #421 (continuous-batching + kv-prefetch) is in review but blocked waiting on the eng-infra runtime image bump. Also saw a small tail-latency bump on long sequences yesterday, need input on whether to change hotpath batching heuristics.

Liam: On the image bump — I have the build job running, ETA ~3pm PT. will drop the image tag here when done.

Maya: FYI platform needs the fallback API change merged so we can wire canary routes. if that lands late it pushes our rollout.

Carla: Who owns the prefetch heuristics tests? I can add unit + smoke if nobody else has it on their plate.

Sasha: @Carla that'd be great — goal is to validate no regressions on small-seq latencies. @Jules can you run the microbench once the image is up? I saw ~6% increase on >1024 tokens in the perf dashboard.

Jules: Yep, I can run benches. Quick note from local runs: seems like batching heuristic sometimes picks larger windows for hotpath when load is bursty. Config excerpt:```yaml
batch_window_ms: 5
priority: hotpath
max_batch_tokens: 2048
```
That `batch_window_ms` is the suspicious knob.

Sasha: My proposal: try hotpath-only reduction to 3ms and enable kv_prefetch=true for canary. keeps throughput but should lower tail.

Maya: +1 from product/platform side. Can we A/B with 10% canary then ramp to 50% if no alerts? Also need a rollback test. :thumbsup:

Sasha: Plan: canary config = new image + batch_window_ms=3 (hotpath override) + kv_prefetch=true. Need eng-infra to publish tag redwood/serve:rv-2026-03-18.

Liam: pushed image: gcr://redwood/serve:rv-2026-03-18, digest sha256:abcd1234efgh5678. Deployed to canary pool (only hotpath nodes).

deploy-bot: canary rollout started — env=canary, pool=hotpath, traffic=10%, image=rv-2026-03-18

Carla: I'll add the test matrix (unit + perf smoke) to the PR branch and kick off a short runtime smoke job against canary.

Sasha: thanks. I'm also adding a short ops runbook for rollback and monitoring thresholds to the PR description.

Maya: quick ping on the code review — left inline comments on the batching change (edge-case around `max_batch_tokens`).

Sasha: saw them, will respond and update the PR today. If benches look good we'll start the ramp tomorrow.

Jules: scheduling bench run now against canary nodes, will post numbers in this thread when done.

Carla: added tests + CI config. kicked off smokejob -> https://ci.internal/reports/1234 (looks green so far).

Sasha: Awesome. If anyone sees odd tail regressions reply here, otherwise milestone updated to "kernel-prefetch-canary" and I flagged owners in the milestone doc.

Liam: noted. I'll watch infra alerts during ramp.

deploy-bot: canary traffic increased to 25% after 30m watch period (automatic ramp)

Maya: sounds good, thanks everyone.
